name: Ethos Furniture Colorado Springs
old_description: Standing tall and proud the mighty Giant Sequoia tree was the inspiration for this modern organic table design. Walking through a Giant Sequoia grove, one is struck by the awe-inspiring size and symmetry of these most mighty of timbers. Inspired by these majestic monoliths, we have paired down their columnar look into this sleek design, perfect for any space. Add a bit of organic flair to your dining space or kitchen with the Sequoia dining table.
about:
Ethos Furniture operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, producing custom-built furniture with a focus on sustainable materials and non-toxic finishes. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials.

The shop specializes in made-to-measure tables, sideboards, and other case goods, using sustainably sourced American hardwoods finished with zero-VOC coatings and premium protectants. It offers complimentary design guidance, available virtually or in person, to help clients specify dimensions, wood species, and finish details. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Ethos serves residential customers and design professionals seeking domestically made, customizable furniture pieces. Its product lineup includes the Sequoia dining table and the Easton sideboard, both offered as starting points for further customization.

The company emphasizes five pillars: made-to-measure design, sustainable American hardwoods, ecoconscious zero-VOC finishes, premium protectants and pigments, and production entirely in the United States. These points frame its differentiation in the custom furniture market.
